hook_type: Catch visible change before it becomes operational loss
core_message: Help agriculture teams move from delayed field insight to near-daily crop intelligence.
buyer_pains: Manual scouting cannot cover every field every day.
Crop stress, disease, irrigation anomalies, and harvest readiness are expensive when detected late.
reusable_hooks: See crop change before it becomes crop loss.
From delayed field insight to near-daily visibility.
Replace field guesswork with daily crop intelligence.
avoid: Do not imply yield gains without evidence.
Do not claim an active customer relationship unless sourced.

hook_type: Make activity visible when traditional signals are incomplete
core_message: Support maritime and mission teams with persistent monitoring, vessel activity intelligence, and high-resolution tasking.
buyer_pains: AIS can be spoofed or unavailable.
Mission planning depends on timely activity changes.
proof_points: SOF Week maritime domain awareness messaging
avoid: Do not invent classified use cases.
Do not use operationally sensitive targeting language.

hook_type: Use objective imagery to accelerate risk and response decisions
core_message: Help risk, civil, and climate teams compare conditions before and after events and act on objective evidence.
buyer_pains: Field assessment is slow, expensive, and sometimes unsafe.
Risk models need current and historical observations.
Disaster response teams need situational awareness across large geographies.
reusable_hooks: Settle claims faster with satellite truth.
Make environmental change visible before it becomes irreversible.
Satellite intelligence on a software budget.
proof_points: AXA disaster management and risk modeling
NASA CSDA and NOAA public-sector access
avoid: Do not imply regulatory compliance without customer-specific evidence.

pattern_name: From satellite data to decision-ready insight
hook_type: Move users from managing geospatial data to finding answers
core_message: Turn high-frequency Earth observation into decision-ready signals for analysts, operators, and researchers.
buyer_pains: Raw imagery and data pipelines can overwhelm teams.
Analysts need timely indicators before slow official data arrives.
Operational users need insight where decisions happen.
reusable_hooks: From satellite data to decision-ready insight.
Move from managing files to finding answers.
Your data, delivered where decisions happen.
avoid: Do not overstate automation replacing human analysis.

hook_type: Identify possible Earth intelligence use cases without overstating fit
core_message: Use conservative account research to explore whether a commercial or adjacent company has a credible Planet use case.
buyer_pains: Potential use cases are indirect or unvalidated.
The account may not match an approved MVP vertical.
Sales and marketing need a clear review gate before outreach.
reusable_hooks: Validate the Earth intelligence fit before campaign launch.
Explore adjacent mapping and logistics intelligence.
Not every account should become a campaign.
proof_points: Adjacent to platform education and mapping workflows, not a confirmed vertical fit.
avoid: Do not pretend the account is a strong fit.
Do not classify commercial technology companies as Government and Civil just because they operate in cities.
